sources.note: The official site identifies Sikkim Supreme (Government Fruit Preservation Factory - GFPF), documents its preserves and processed foods, and publishes its Singtam location or contact. The current official site and its published contact/about routes were reviewed and expose no remote-order mechanism.

notes: Coordinates use the Singtam municipal centroid as a coarse fallback.

sources.note: The official estate site places the garden and factory at Temi and offers its current teas through an online shop.
The producer-operated shop exposes current products and an order or checkout flow.

notes: No reliable coordinate was available for the productive unit; the municipality is retained without a map point.
